snippet.title: Black Walls - Release Date Reveal Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4827960/BLACK_WALLS/

A cinematic release date trailer for Black Walls. Explore a silent, dark maze where observation is everything. Calm, meditative, and mysterious. Light and shadow puzzles reveal hidden paths. Carefully interpret symbolic items, choices shape your ending.
